name: Unwanted and Unworthy

angles.text: On Zephras, the Al'Aketh Cultists spilled local druids' blood in an unprovoked assault. As a druid, you answer with vengeance and defend nature's balance.

faq.answer: The Al'Aketh Cultists are storm-obsessed cultists on Zephras. Elegael once thought them foolish dreamers, with clouds between their ears, but they turned to brutal violence against the local druids.

Elegael is a shen'dorei protector or druid on Zephras. The Al'Aketh Cultists ambushed Elegael, and the betrayal and bloodshed of young lives have left Elegael distressed. Elegael seeks retribution and the recovery of stolen ancestral heirlooms.

The bloodied heirlooms belonged to young shen'dorei drawn into the Al'Aketh Cult. Elegael gathers them to return to the High Elder's collection, where they can pass to a more worthy future generation.
The shen'dorei are the people who inhabit Zephras. Elegael believes the Al'Aketh Cultists forfeited their right to the name through violent betrayal and desecration of the island's harmony.
Shadowgale Forest is a wooded region on Zephras. Al'Aketh Footsoldiers and Stormchasers operate there, and the cultists ambushed the druids there.
Elegael does not know the cultists' exact motives. Once dismissed as harmless zealots, they rose in sudden, vicious violence and shattered the delicate balance on the island.
faq.q: Why did the Al'Aketh Cultists ambush the druids?

sections.body: The Al'Aketh Cultists ambush the local druids in Shadowgale Forest. Elegael had thought these zealots harmless dreamers, with clouds between their ears. Now druid blood stains the forest floor, and Elegael demands swift retribution against the Footsoldiers and Stormchasers responsible.
sections.title: Ambush in Shadowgale Forest

sections.body:
Elegael believes the cultists' betrayal has cost them their heritage. They no longer deserve the name shen'dorei, nor do their remains deserve the winds of their homeland. Many were young, their promising futures cut short by fanaticism.

Their bloodied heirlooms must return to the High Elder. There, the sacred items await a wiser and more worthy generation.
sections.title: Tainted Heirlooms and Lost Youth

summary: On Zephras, bloodshed in Shadowgale Forest drives Elegael to seek vengeance and recover stolen heirlooms for the High Elder.
